ground_truth.main_content:
Badcaps Capacitor & Electronics Repair Forum

Frequently Asked Questions (No Posting)
All new members, PLEASE READ HERE FIRST! Posting only allowed by established members.

Announcements & Related News
Site announcements, capacitor-related news, and anything relavant you might think of... Got News? POST IT!!

Document & Software Archive

Schematics and Boardviews
Share or download schematics and boardview files. Contribute your knowledge or ask questions. Before using please read our Terms of Service.

Common Parts Library - Datasheets
Share or download datasheets or application notes for electronic components and other parts. Contribute your knowledge or ask questions. Before using please read our Terms of Service.

General Topics

General Capacitor Questions & Issues
Questions and answers for identifying whether your device has bad capacitors. Also post general capacitor-related questions and issues here.

General Computer & Tech Discussion
Have just a general computer question, post it here. This can be anything from an OS issue, hardware issue not related to capacitors, upgrade question, or whatever basic tech-related issue is on your mind.... This is also a good place to share your tech projects!

Troubleshooting Hardware & Devices and Electronics Theory

General Electronics Technical Discussion
If you have a general question concerning basic electronics theory or component function & usage, here's where it goes.

Troubleshooting Desktop Motherboards, Graphics Cards, and PC Peripherals
Technical discussions covering any type of desktop motherboard, video/graphics card, controller card, or whatever other desktop peripheral you need help with. Any and all brands and models welcome. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting & Designing Networks
Post your computer network questions, ideas, gripes, and so on in here. This can be any type of network, whether its cabled, wireless, or whatever. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Laptops, Tablets, and Mobile Devices
Technical discussions covering any type of laptop, notebook, netbook, tablet, or smartphone. Any and all brands and models welcome. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Computer Displays
Technical discussions covering any type of PC/computer display, whether it be CRT, LCD, or anything else. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting TVs and Video Sources
Technical questions about your defective television, projection screen, LCD/plasma, or any other type of video device. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Power Supplies and Power Supply Design
Technical discussion for power supplies. This covers PC supplies, and any other related power supply issue. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Printers, Copiers, Scanners and other Imaging & Printing Devices
Technical questions about your defective laser or ink printer, plotter, copier, scanner, and other imaging & printing devices. This section also includes digital cameras. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Audio Equipment
Technical discussion on audio equipment troubleshooting and installation. This can be anything from a home/car stereo, guitar amp, and so on. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Appliances and other Household Electronic Stuff
Technical discussion on household appliances & other household electrics & electronics; including troubleshooting and installation. This can be anything from a washer/dryer, dishwasher, microwave oven, other sordid kitchen electrics and so on. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Troubleshooting Game Consoles & Other Weird Devices
This can be anything from game consoles to arcade games to anything else that doesn't really fit into any of the above categories. When starting a new thread, please put the make AND model of your device in the thread title. Also be VERY descriptive of your issue, that way you'll get the best answer possible!

Equipment Usage, Soldering, Techniques, and Reviews
Technical discussions concerning soldering techniques, usage of test equipment, how it works, what's best, and some pointers in using it all.

Specifications

Laptop, Tablet, & Notebook Specifications
Basic specifications for laptops, tablets, & notebooks. We are constantly adding new content like boardviews, schematics, fixes, and other data here.

Server, iMac, & Desktop PC Specifications
Basic specifications for server, iMac, & desktop computers. We are constantly adding new content like boardviews, schematics, fixes, and other data here.
